item.name: Syrian Cities Integration
item.description: Structured Syrian city support is additive. Keep sending/reading free-text location; city_id is nullable and city is a localized object. Accept-Language controls city.name and matching messages.

request.description: Public. Returns active SY cities by default. Query: search (code, Arabic name, English name), active_only (boolean). Response item: {id, code, name, country_code}.

Employer/company authorization is unchanged. city_id is optional but, when present, must identify an active Syrian city. Remote jobs may send city_id=null.
